definitions.floor: The OpenSea listing floor is reported in notes as context only; it does not seed, replace or enter the TWAP.
definitions.price: Total buyer payment, counted once: seller proceeds + royalties + protocol fees. Seaport listing fill = sum of NATIVE/WETH consideration items; Seaport bid or matched pair = sum of NATIVE/WETH offer items of the buyer-side order (its currency consideration legs are paid out of that same offer). Blur = the packed price word, which equals tx value on side 0.
definitions.venue: Every marketplace is eligible, ETH-settled Blur Execution721Packed fills included alongside Seaport; only the settlement currency, never the venue, excludes a fill.
definitions.metric: Last-sale TWAP: P(t) = unit price of the latest qualifying executed secondary BAYC sale at or before t, held constant until the next one; answer = floor(integral over [1790018145,1790104545) of P(t) dt / 86400) in wei. Not a floor TWAP, VWAP, mean or minimum.
definitions.currency: Only fills whose buyer payment is native ETH or canonical WETH 0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2, valued 1:1 at 18 decimals. Blur Pool ETH 0x0000000000a39bb272e79075ade125fd351887ac and USDC are not on that whitelist and their fills are excluded, whatever the venue.
definitions.ordering: Fills sorted by block timestamp, blockNumber, transactionIndex, logIndex. At an equal timestamp the last in that order supplies P(t) afterwards and earlier ones get zero duration. Exact integer arithmetic throughout; floor applied only to the final wei result.
definitions.settlement: A fill needs a successful receipt and a decoded settlement event naming the token id: Seaport 1.6 OrderFulfilled with resolved items, or Blur v2 Execution721Packed. An ERC721 Transfer alone, a Blend loan or repayment, or a bundle without per-fill allocation is not a sale.

definitions.seed: Latest qualifying sale before start within seven days was BAYC #8582 at timestamp 1790013587, transaction 0xe6fd7d4e3917742b46df5509c1bc0b32e70c71e245a4d4fe74ed5579635c6776, for 6130000000000000000 wei.
definitions.collection: Bored Ape Yacht Club only: ERC-721 0xbc4ca0eda7647a8ab7c2061c2e118a18a936f13d; OpenSea slug boredapeyachtclub.
definitions.floor_context: OpenSea collection stats endpoint returned current total.floor_price 6.848 ETH (scope: all Ethereum BAYC listings) at 2026-09-22T19:45:55Z; this contextual listing floor was neither a seed nor an input to the TWAP.
definitions.time_weighting: P(t) is the last qualifying unit sale price at or before t, ordered by block timestamp, block number, transaction index, and settlement log index. It is carried to the next fill; the interval is [1790018145,1790104545), 86400 seconds, and only the final quotient is floored.
definitions.qualifying_fill: Successful settled secondary ERC-721 fills with exactly one BAYC token and ETH or WETH consideration/offer only; price is total buyer payment including fees, counted once. Zero-price, plain transfers, mints, and mixed-collection bundles are excluded.
